source_title: Yogi Adityanath says UP emerging as major investment hub, flags Singapore delegation meet - India Today
source_excerpt:
The chief minister said Uttar Pradesh lacked a clear vision and a concrete action plan to attract global investment before 2017, when the previous government was in power.
Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath on Wednesday said the state was emerging as a major hub for investment, innovation and industry, attributing the changes since 2017 to improved law and order, transparent policies and an investment-friendly environment.
In a post on X, Adityanath said Uttar Pradesh lacked a clear vision and a concrete action plan to attract global investment before 2017, when the previous government was in power.
“Under the able leadership of PM Narendra Modi, a new work culture for investment and industrial development was developed in the state with the mantra of Reform, Perform and Transform,” he said.
The chief minister said the state government was working to build on growing global confidence in Uttar Pradesh.
He said a meeting with a Singapore delegation would focus on identifying new investment opportunities, accelerating ongoing projects and translating investment commitments into actual production.
CM Adityanath also reiterated the state government’s ambition of making Uttar Pradesh a USD 1 trillion economy, linking investment-led industrial growth with employment generation and improved household prosperity.
“With the resolve that every investment will lead to a new industry, every industry will generate new employment and every job will bring prosperity to families, Uttar Pradesh is moving towards becoming a one trillion-dollar economy,” he said. - Ends
